title: A Treatise on Steel Skin and Plate
summary: A treatise that turns the hardened skin into plate: a body shield that holds a long exchange, and a crushing blow taken from behind it.

title: The Canon of the Cutting Line
summary: A canon on sending the cut of a blade out along a thin line of metal qi, so a stroke reaches past the edge and cleaves what it meets.

title: The Metal Halo Beyond the Body
summary: Teaches the cultivator to hold metal qi as a living halo round the body, sharp on its rim, which blunts blows and cuts what enters it.

title: A Manual of Grown Armor
summary: A manual on growing full armor of metal from the qi in the air, piece by piece, then shedding it as a storm of plates.

title: Treatise of the Anvil Stroke
summary: An Azorion treatise on striking as a hammer strikes the anvil, with a rooted stance and a blow that rings through the target.

title: Compendium of Hanging Blades
summary: An Azorion compendium on raising blades of metal qi that hang about the cultivator and fly at his bidding.

title: The Loom of Wires
summary: An Azorion manual on weaving wires of metal qi into guards, webs and nets that catch a foe.

title: Course of the Many Needles
summary: A Gale course in loosing needles of metal qi in numbers too great to turn aside, fast and from many directions.

title: Compendium of Chain and Hook
summary: A Gale compendium on chains with barbed hooks of metal qi that drag a foe in, anchor the cultivator and bring down a guard.

title: A Treatise on Flowing Silver
summary: A Gale treatise that carries the quicksilver lessons to a floodlike scale, with the cleansing and soothing touch of silver qi alongside.
